content.title: Masters full TV, streaming coverage schedule for 2026
content.text: March 25, 2026Updated April 6, 2026, 2:21 p.m. ETThe full coverage schedule for the 2026 Masters was revealed Wednesday morning.Nine different channels and streaming platforms will get a piece of the pie this year, with Amazon Prime Video making its debut. Along with the main broadcast, there are six alternate feeds on the docket throughout the week. Here's how you can catch all the action at the 2026 Masters:How to watch the 2026 Masters main broadcastPrime Video will carry the event for the first time ever with two hours of streaming coverage for the first and second rounds, from 1-3 p.m. ET on Thursday and Friday. ESPN will provide linear cable coverage for those two days, from 3-7:30 p.m. ET, picking up where Amazon Prime leaves off.On the weekend, the main feed will be handed over to CBS. The first two hours of coverage on Saturday and Sunday will air exclusively on Paramount+, starting at noon ET, before the network takes over for the remainder of each round.Watch the Masters on Amazon Prime VideoAll main feed coverage for all four days can also be found on Masters.com and the Masters App. Here's a breakdown of the main broadcast schedule for the 2026 Masters:Thursday and Friday (April 9-10)Prime Video: 1-3 p.m. ETESPN/ESPN App: 3-7:30 p.m. ETSaturday and Sunday (April 11-12)Paramount+: 12-2 p.m. ETCBS/Paramount+: 2-7 p.m. ETMasters 2026 featured groups, alternate feedsAside from the main feed, there is a wide range of viewing options available on a host of different streaming platforms throughout the week.All of it will be familiar to golf fans except for one new addition. Amazon Prime will debut a data and stats-based feed called "Inside Amen Corner," which will also air live on Masters.com and the Masters App. The usual suspects like On the Range, featured groups and the traditional Amen Corner broadcast are also included in the coverage lineup and will be carried by several different streamersOn the Range (Monday-Sunday)CBS Sports Network, Paramount+, Masters AppMasters Par 3 Contest (Wednesday)ESPN, ESPN App, Disney+, Masters AppFeatured groups (Thursday-Sunday)CBS Digital, Paramount+, ESPN App, Prime Video, DirecTV, Masters AppHoles 4, 5 and 6 (Thursday-Sunday)CBS Digital, Paramount+, ESPN App, Prime Video, DirecTV, Masters AppAmen Corner (Thursday-Sunday)CBS Digital, Paramount+, ESPN App, Prime Video, DirecTV, Masters AppInside Amen Corner (Thursday-Sunday)Prime Video, Masters AppHoles 15 and 16 (Thursday-Sunday)CBS Digital, Paramount+, ESPN App, Prime Video, DirecTV, Masters AppOur editors independently choose our recommendations.
